title: Kingdom Hearts - Chain of Memories
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 1100000768 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Action RPG. The RA notes mark HP/floor as EU-version addresses; only play time, max HP and world kept (max HP from a note without region mark). Live values from RA notes, not checked in a running game unless said. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: Every attack, magic and item is a card in the deck; the deck has a Card Point (CP) limit set by level.
widgets.label: Cards

widgets.text: A use card, R/L scroll deck, R+L stock 3 cards for a sleight.
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text: Cards have numbers 0-9: a higher card breaks a lower one. 0 cards break anything played before them but break easily.
widgets.label: Card values

widgets.text: 3 stocked cards in certain combos make sleights (e.g. Sonic Blade, Strike Raid, Lethal Frame).
widgets.label: Sleights

widgets.text: Hold back 0 cards to break boss sleights. Reload (hold R) when the deck runs out: each reload costs more time. Enemy cards drop and give buffs.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Each floor is a Disney world made from a World Card: Traverse Town, Agrabah, Olympus Coliseum, Wonderland, Monstro, Halloween Town, Atlantica, Neverland, Hollow Bastion, 100 Acre Wood, Twilight Town, Destiny Islands.
widgets.label: Floors

widgets.text: Room cards build each floor: red (enemies), green (Sora buffs), blue (special rooms like save points, Moogle shop).
widgets.label: Map cards

widgets.text: Card collection includes attack, magic, item, summon, enemy cards; Moogle shop sells card packs for Moogle points.
widgets.label: Collect

widgets.text: Climb Castle Oblivion floor by floor, beat Organization XIII members (Larxene, Vexen, Marluxia...). Reverse/Rebirth: Riku's story after clearing Sora's.
widgets.label: Goal
